The cake — built in front of you

Thirty years, four layers

01 — THE SPONGE

It starts plain

One golden vanilla sponge, baked that morning. No decoration, no shortcuts — like the first decade.

02 — THE CREAM

Then it gets smoother

A second layer, mascarpone cream between and above. The twenties: softer edges, better taste.

03 — THE BERRIES

Colour arrives

Raspberries, figs and dark cherries with a whisper of gold leaf. Nothing about thirty is beige.

04 — THE CANDLES

Make it official

Four tall candles — one for every seven and a half years of excellent decisions. At 9:30 PM, Elena blows. Be there.

The evening — Saturday 18 September

How the night runs

Times are London time. The list keeps itself honest — each line flips from coming to now to done as the night actually happens.

Dinner — three courses

On the table

To start
Burrata, fig & prosciutto

Aged balsamic, grilled sourdough, basil oil. (Vegetarian without the prosciutto — same plate, no apology.)

The main
Slow beef short rib — or — miso-glazed aubergine

Chosen on your RSVP, plated at 19:45. Salmon and vegan options are on the form too.

To finish
The birthday cake, obviously

The sponge, cream and berries from the build above — plus a raspberry coulis nobody asked for and everybody takes.

Dress code — cocktail

Cocktail, with plum, gold and cream warmly welcomed. The floor is marble — bring the shoes you can dance in anyway.

Questions — answered

Before you ask

If your invitation says +1, yes — put their name and their main course on your RSVP and they get their own guest pass at the door. Seats are counted at 60, so unlisted guests sadly can't be added on the night.

The Palm Court is ours until 00:30. The cake moment is 21:30 — if you can only make part of the night, make it that part.

Berkeley Square NCP is three minutes away. Green Park tube is four. Night buses N8 and N15 stop two minutes from the door — the planner's choice.

Yes. Open this page on the same phone, tap “Edit my reply”, and change anything until 21 August. Your guest-pass code stays the same.
